focus: Canonicalize the menu byte that brackets the controller-port handshake and routes unavailable polls away from selection handling.
contracts: Menu_RunOptionsPresentationContinuation stores 0xFF to 0x00FFEFFE before the primary-selection controller poll at 0x001B3E6E.
The controller-port handshake occupies 0x001B3F52 through 0x001B3F98 and clears 0x00FFEFFE at 0x001B3FDC after the successful handshake path.
Reads at 0x001B3F9C and 0x001B4044 test the byte before selecting menu-state handling; INPUT_EDGE_LATCH at 0x00FFEFFD remains a distinct action debounce latch.
conclusion: The controller-handshake byte is a menu-local controller-poll/availability gate, not another presentation or input-edge state.
